estimator.center: per-size intrinsic root of the orientation-mean q curve, recomputed inside every delete-one score
estimator.source: complex same-size P4 mean J_D4, with J_D4=chi4(P*ell)(I12-I01)
estimator.direct_0_to_2: zero contribution because ell=null and D=0

primary_targets.joint: fit one real exponent alpha to both complex edges under alternating sign; compare alpha=13/8 to alpha=0 and free complex transfers

secondary_controls: all complement endpoint/site/line/local/index audits exactly zero
each edge phase residual reported before magnitude/exponent
N65 and N130 production are fresh replicas, not reuse of the 20k pilot
cross-size counters are aligned identifiers but only within-size orientation pairs share an exact permutation field

power_and_runtime.interpretation: 5m is discovery-grade for the complex two-step chain, not a precision exponent determination

claim_boundary.primary: mean J_D4 only; the connected A_top response is excluded by the exact contact no-go
claim_boundary.heldout: N260 outcome and second q2 transfer
claim_boundary.not_claimed: field identity from a two-edge exponent match without independent modular or external-observer evidence
